# PixelFizz

> Digital Engineering Studio & Full-Stack Web Architecture Consultancy  
> Operating out of Vapi, Gujarat, India (`https://pixelfizz.in`) and Winchester, Hampshire, UK (`https://pixelfizz.co.uk`).

## Overview
PixelFizz is a boutique digital engineering agency specializing in high-performance Next.js web applications, headless e-commerce architectures, custom business ERP/SaaS systems, and autonomous AI voice and workflow automations. We build production systems with clean, zero-bloat code, sub-second load times, and perfect Core Web Vitals (95+ score).

## Core Service Offerings
- **High-Speed Next.js Web Development**: Server-side rendered (SSR), static-generated (SSG), and edge-cached web platforms built on Next.js 14/15, React 19, and TailwindCSS.
- **Headless E-Commerce Boutiques**: Bespoke online storefronts utilizing Shopify Storefront APIs, custom cart engines, WhatsApp checkout automations, and Razorpay/Stripe integrations.
- **Autonomous AI Voice & Workflow Automations**: Real-time voice agents powered by Twilio, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, ElevenLabs, and Deepgram for 24/7 client booking, appointment qualification, and inbound triage.
- **Custom Business Software (SaaS / ERP)**: Tailored inventory management, POS billing, touch kitchen display systems (KDS), and team portals built on PostgreSQL, Supabase, and Flutter.
- **Cross-Platform Mobile Apps**: Production iOS and Android applications built in Flutter, featuring offline database synchronization, biometrics, and media projection.
- **Technical SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Structured JSON-LD schema, programmatic sitemaps, clean semantic hierarchy, and brand optimization for Google Search, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.

## Flagship Builds & Case Studies
- **Sajraah Menswear** (`https://shreemahavircreation.in`): Custom D2C menswear boutique with custom inventory control, Razorpay checkout, COD SMS confirmation, and sub-second page performance.
- **Kagrecha's Realty** (`https://kagrecharealty.in`): Real estate search portal featuring 926+ verified property listings, instant search filtering, and 1-tap WhatsApp lead routing.
- **Winchester Health Centre**: Private UK travel vaccination and clinical booking portal in Winchester, Hampshire, featuring automated slot reservation and GDPR compliance.
- **DM Claims Ireland** (`https://dmclaims.ie`): Independent insurance loss assessor platform serving Ireland and the UK with an interactive property damage selector and instant emergency response callback dispatch.
- **Guldaar Valley**: Hospitality management suite for luxury resort homestays, integrating guest room reservation, touch cafe POS, and kitchen KDS.
- **StreamTwin** (Google Play Store): Native Android screen projection and RTMP broadcast engineering application.
- **Cadre Management App** (Google Play Store): Offline-first community tracking and biometrics management application.
- **Vardhaman Adhesive** (`https://vardhmanadhesive.com`): High-speed industrial chemical adhesives portal and quotation catalog.
